updates.title: Bug Reports
updates.summary: Something not right? Type /bb report and tell us what happened. It sends us your last games' game messages and scoreboard, never your chat.

sections.heading: Report a bug from in game
items: /bb report what went wrong sends us your last few games so we can see what the mod saw
Only the game's own messages, the scoreboard and what the mod worked out; chat, private messages, guild, party and friend messages are left out on your PC
Nothing is sent unless you type the command

updates.title: Update Notices
updates.summary: The mod now tells you when a newer version is out, and there is a Fabric build for Minecraft 26.2.

sections.heading: Stay up to date
items: A green "Update available" line on the main menu whenever a newer version has been released
A chat message when you join, and a banner on What's New with the release notes and download link
Nothing downloads automatically; you can switch the chat message off in Settings

sections.heading: Tidy-ups
items: Teams games now get a crowd score and grade, graded against the number of teams
Podium finishes in Solo, Pro and Teams now save your score, and tied teams on the podium are recognised
Guess the Build games are now tracked, with your place and points from the final scoreboard even outside the top 3, and while nicked
New Fabric build for Minecraft 26.2, next to 26.3 and Forge 1.8.9
The Credits screen and /bb credits are gone
When an upload fails, the message now says why and suggests /bb sync; one invalid game no longer holds back the rest

updates.title: Your Next Achievement
updates.summary: A proper home for your next goal: readable achievement details, daily recommendations and up to three pinned goals on your HUD.

sections.heading: Find your next goal
items: Select an achievement to read its full description, modes, AP and unlock date in a side panel
Five daily recommendations, tailored to the modes you play and your progress
Filter by Solo, Teams, Pro, GTB or Speed Builders, and show locked, unlocked or pinned goals
Pin up to three achievements to a compact HUD; goals unpin when you unlock them
A full-page detail view on smaller screens, plus full-description hover tooltips

sections.heading: Nineteen new challenges
items: Half Measures: win using only slabs; Open for Business: win using only menu-opening blocks
Down to Earth: win Teams without jumping
Score milestones for winning with 200, 300, 350 or 400 points
Relentless and Unbeatable: 25- and 50-game win streaks; Mind over Matter: three consecutive GTB wins
Solo, Teams and Pro Repertoire: win on 10, 25 and 50 distinct themes in each mode

updates.title: The Speed Builders Update
updates.summary: Speed Builders gets the attention it deserves: a timer, personal bests, world records and six new challenges. Plus game recaps, weekly challenges you can actually see, and a settings screen.

sections.heading: Speed Builders
items: A timer while you build, with your best time on that build next to it
Personal bests for every build, saved even when you're offline
Better Battle world records, with a leaderboard for each build on the website
Precision: how many of your clicks actually ended up in the build

sections.heading: New challenges
items: Feet on the Ground: win a Speed Builders game without flying
Good Enough: win without a Perfect Build in every round
Assembly Line: win placing one block type at a time
Photo Finish: a Perfect Build with less than a second left
From the Bottom: win after the slowest Perfect Build in round 1
Speedrunner: win with more than half the clock left in every round
Measure Twice now works: win without breaking a single block

sections.heading: After every game
items: A recap in chat: placement, grade, crowd score, XP and what you unlocked
Last Game in the B menu shows the full breakdown, round by round
Share a card of your profile from the website

sections.heading: Everything else
items: Weekly challenges in the B menu and on your profile, with a countdown to the Monday reset
See how rare each achievement is, and compare yourself with another player
A Settings screen: every new feature can be switched off if you'd rather play normally

updates.title: First release
updates.summary: Better Battle tracks your Build Battle games, grades your builds and puts you on a global ranking.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Every game saved on your computer first, then synced
Grades, crowd score and the Aspiring Level
Over 100 achievements, many unlocked from your existing Hypixel stats
Profiles and a global ranking at battle.aspir3.net
